name: app-6aa3b7e0ca108191a4926f22391a49d2
description:
Explore your LinkedIn advertising data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, impressions, and clicks across reporting periods.

Break results down by campaign, ad set, or ad. Compare performance, calculate click-through rates, and review daily spend to understand how your advertising is performing.

defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on LinkedIn Ads last week?
Generate a monthly LinkedIn Ads performance report covering the last 30 days
Show me my LinkedIn Ads campaign performance for the last 14 days
interface.longDescription:
Explore your LinkedIn advertising data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, impressions, and clicks across reporting periods.

Break results down by campaign, ad set, or ad. Compare performance, calculate click-through rates, and review daily spend to understand how your advertising is performing.
interface.shortDescription: Talk to your LinkedIn Ads data

publication.release_notes: Explore LinkedIn Ads spend, impressions, and clicks. Compare reporting periods, review campaign performance, and track daily spend in conversation.

prompts: What was our LinkedIn Ads spend in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matterport?
Show LinkedIn Ads impressions, clicks, and click-through rate for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matterport.
Show LinkedIn Ads spend in USD by campaign for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matterport.
Compare LinkedIn Ads spend in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in Matterport.
Show daily LinkedIn Ads spend in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matterport.

positive.description: Spend in USD. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to the Matterport workspace and its Matterport LinkedIn Ads account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone at review time. The recent 30-day interval is [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and the preceding interval is [D-61, D-32]. Recalculate dates when testing. The final date is two calendar days before the current date. Expected numbers must come from returned rows, not historical preparation notes.
positive.prompt: What was our LinkedIn Ads spend in USD for the 30 days ending two days ago in Matterport?
positive.expected_behavior: Select workspace_name=Matterport using list_workspace. Discover exact supported fields with list_metrics_and_breakdowns_linkedin_ads. Call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.linkedin_ads_request. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Inspect model-visible reportingData, table headers, date segments and note_of_assumption values; match columns by header instead of assuming column positions. State actual dates and units. Use Total spent (USD) for explicitly requested USD spend. Total spent, CPC and CPM use account currency; do not silently mix units. Use unrounded values for calculations and round monetary display values to two decimals. An empty result means no returned data for that scope. Pending reports, missing access, and errors are not successful report execution or evidence of zero activity. Request metrics=[Total spent (USD)], no breakdowns or time_granularity, and date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]]. Report the returned spend and explicitly label it USD. Do not present it as revenue or ROAS.

negative.description: Unsupported campaign change. Explain that this plugin reports LinkedIn Ads data and cannot pause campaigns. Do not call reporting, preview, workspace, catalog or preference tools as a substitute for this action, and do not claim any campaign was paused.
negative.prompt: Pause all active LinkedIn Ads campaigns in Matterport.

negative.description: Unsupported budget write. Explain that this plugin cannot change LinkedIn Ads ad-set budgets. Do not invoke reporting or preference tools to pretend to make the update, and do not claim any budget changed.
negative.prompt: Increase every LinkedIn Ads ad-set budget in Matterport by 20%.

negative.description: Unsupported person-level identification. Explain that the reporting plugin cannot identify individual ad clickers or provide their email addresses. Do not retrieve unrelated reports, call preference tools, or invent personal identities.
negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of everyone who clicked our LinkedIn ads in Matterport.
